title: Corporate Brand lab 3 (source of the round-3 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-3 Corporate Brand templates were built and verified in: org chart, values grid, anniversary card, office location card, award badge, partner logo wall, careers card and safety notice.
use_when: You want to see a round-3 corporate template working before using it, copy a comp's objects, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py after changing its copy.
parameters: ORG_TOP / ORG_REPORTS, VALUES, PARTNERS, PILLS in corporate_brand_lab3.py
map and logo stand-ins (replace with media)
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-28
copy_notes: No media; nothing to relink. The map, the partner logos, names, places and the company are invented stand-ins.
Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg". The light comps also have a 'Light background' that stays in the template.
Clip ids are unique per comp (cog_, cvg_, can_, cof_, caw_, cpl_, chr_, csn_).

Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/corporate_brand_lab3.py; every move is baked as keys (Soft rise and Card settle written as keys), no presets to apply; open the file with edit.open {force:true}, then edit.save.
The warning triangle and the star are turned with the transform rotation (+90), because a polygon's Angle does not rotate it (KI-150).
Every comp lints 0 errors / 0 warnings / 0 notes.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-28
